payload_semantics: Full template is associated with the observed movement; byte 6 alone is not a universal command map.
pid: frames_queued modulo 4, increment per transmitted envelope
radio_crc: CRC16 CCITT polynomial 0x1021 initial 0xffff over air address + 9-bit PCF + scrambled payload, excluding guards
limits: One successful observed control, direction and stop confirmed by user.
Other movements, startup binding and a dedicated neutral packet are not established.
No movement replay is authorized by opening the port; ARM/FIRE and fresh host token are required.

repeatability.note: Three out of three right-turn repeats and self-stops confirmed.
